parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Define electric field at a point.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: An isolated conducting sphere in a vacuum has a capacitance of $69\text{ pF}$. The charge on the sphere is $+83\text{ pC}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
On Fig. 6.1, draw field lines to represent the electric field outside the sphere due to the charge on the sphere.

{{figure:figure_6_1.png}}

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the electric potential at the surface of the sphere.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the radius of the sphere.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Calculate the electric field strength $E$ at the surface of the sphere. Give a unit with your answer.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The sphere in (b) is discharged by connecting it to earth ($0\text{ V}$) through a resistor of resistance $120\text{ M}\Omega$.

Calculate the time taken for the charge to fall to $26\text{ pC}$.
